No rule licenses interpreting EVERY adjacent occurrence in the larger census as this same constituent.

S.title: Aufbereitungslesung: frisches/getrocknetes Material und Verfahren

readings.f28v.4: Vorrat: geschnittene frische Wurzel und Rinde; ein Ansatz mit Samen, abgemessen, bereit.
readings.f2v.8: Aufbewahrung von frischer Wurzel: gemahlene getrocknete Wurzel, verschlossen.
readings.f58r.18: Vorrat an Flüssigkeit; daraus Wurzelsaft, Wurzelportionen, Pulver. Zuletzt abteilen in ein Gefäß: geröstete getrocknete Blätter.
readings.f75r.36: Salz: erwärmen, auflösen. Anschließend: gekochte frische Blätter. Abteilen, abteilen, fertig.

claims: Four learned nominal wholes contrast fresh/dried states; four learned modifier wholes contrast operations.
No written token independently establishes physical freshness, drying, cutting, grinding, boiling or roasting.
Before/after processing and material identity are not asserted merely from the sequence of two labels.
Cut dried roots, grind fresh roots, boil dried leaves and roast fresh leaves are not excluded by this lexicon; no physical compatibility ranking is scored.

consequences.claim_S: chor/otar name fresh material, chol/otal dried material
consequences.bridge: A written nominal is bound to a visible referent with independently assessable numerosity and processing state; the image actually depicts these attributes.
consequences.observable: Referent count and preparation state at all corresponding occurrences
consequences.prediction_N: r nominal plural and l nominal singular; freshness/drying unspecified
consequences.prediction_S: r nominal fresh and l nominal dried; number unspecified
consequences.reason: Text packet has no independently identified pictured referent or state. Source words cannot measure their own meaning.

consequences.claim_N: A modifier and its nominal agree in number inside a constituent
consequences.claim_S: Operation and material state are separately assigned
consequences.bridge: EVERY exact adjacent pair in both nominated ordered families is one modifier-nominal constituent, across all its occurrences.
consequences.observable: rr/rl/lr/ll cells among every exact definite-space pair
consequences.prediction_N: Under this added universal attachment bridge: rl=lr=0
consequences.prediction_S: No forbidden cell under this lexicon; no probabilistic frequency prediction
consequences.reason: Cells are written and countable; universal constituent ownership is not independently known. Mixed cells already known from GDT915. This is an implication audit, not a new agreement test.

consequences.claim_N: At f2v.8 plural roots precede one cut root
consequences.claim_S: At f2v.8 fresh root precedes ground dried root
consequences.bridge: All three nominal appearances designate the same material individual and the line documents a transition, rather than a list/class/sample relation.
consequences.observable: Independently bound source/result identity and explicit transition relation
consequences.prediction_N: Would need a group-to-member or division interpretation to connect plural and singular
consequences.prediction_S: Would need drying plus grinding to connect fresh and dried material
consequences.reason: No explicit independently read identity/transition is supplied. Neither model is credited with these missing operations.

consequences.claim_N: Freshness not encoded by the N core
consequences.claim_S: Number not encoded by the S core
consequences.bridge: A new phrase occurrence must carry an independently known state or number, not just another r/l pair.
consequences.observable: Later source context with independently constrained count/state
consequences.prediction_N: A bare repetition alone gives the same number assignment
consequences.prediction_S: A bare repetition alone gives the same state assignment
consequences.reason: All54 matches in the scoped text census provide written occurrences; no additional semantic annotation is admitted. Repetition does not discriminate.

consequences.claim_N: dardardy rendered as two divisions and completion
consequences.bridge: Whole-token rendering equivalence across alternate reader segmentations
consequences.observable: ZL dardardy versus IT/RF dar dar dy at f75r.36
consequences.reason: Observed reader disagreement retained, no boundary normalization. It does not separate N/S or establish a dar or dy meaning.

assumptions: All34 German whole-form glosses per candidate are stipulated, including root/leaf identities.
German gender/declension is presentation, not a known Voynich language.
Punctuation and phrase/record scopes are supplied. Full physical lines do not prove full sentences.
Same vocabulary items across leaves are material classes, not conserved individual objects.
The common word values were authored jointly in this experiment, not independent agreement of readers.
dardardy and dar/dy are separate whole-form entries; no productive decomposition is learned.
Uncertain RF groups remain open; their clear neighboring words retain candidate values.
No visual inspection, new text admission, reserve, expert contact or external source was used.
